factions.name: Aurelian Dynamics
factions.description: The corporation that owns the Spire, the power grid and most of the city's debt. It collects in credits, in chrome and, when those run out, in memories and years of labour.

factions.name: The Lantern Saints
factions.description: Lowtide's biggest gang, who hang paper lanterns over their turf and run the drowned metro. They tax the noodle stalls and fight off Aurelian's repo crews, and they will tell you those are the same thing.

factions.name: Lowtide
factions.description: The cooks, medics, singers and dockhands who keep the flooded district alive. Nobody is in charge of them, which is how they like it.
